description: Granville Parking real-time status is a dataset listed in Cumberland open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Cumberland City Council. This datasets contains real-time status of parking spaces equipped with sensors. parkflag=1 indicates that the parking spot is currently occupied parkflag=0 indicates that the parking spot is currently available lastupdated indicates time of the most recent movement on the parking space. Coverage: Cumberland, New South Wales. The portal files it under Transport, Movements. Its keywords are parking. The portal shows 75 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-05-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-cumberland-portal.
